summary: BIONIC™ Frontend Integration Testing - EnvironmentAnalysisPanelEnhanced component verified. Page /territoire loads correctly with new panel. All 3 tabs (Global, Végétation, Géologie) display. Species selector works with 6 species. SIGÉOM WMS layers available in left panel. Backend APIs (Sentinel, SIGÉOM) return correct data. Hydro panel functional.

integration_issues.issue: Global/Sentinel/SIGÉOM analyses show loading spinners for extended periods (>10s). This is expected behavior per task description but may affect UX.
integration_issues.note: Expected behavior - APIs call Open-Meteo, Open-Elevation, SIGÉOM

✅ SIGÉOM (Géologie) layers in left panel with 3 couches
✅ Détail Hydrologique panel functional (Score Hydrologique displayed)
✅ Météo & Score panel working (-5°C to -11°C, score 65 'bon')
✅ Backend API /api/bionic/sentinel/analyze/point returns NDVI, EVI, SAVI, NDWI indices
✅ Backend API /api/bionic/sigeom/analyze returns geological province and rock types
✅ Waypoints and Score tabs switch correctly
